canonical_name: Shared System Resource Protection Not Implemented
description: Protection mechanisms for shared system resources are not implemented to prevent unauthorized data disclosure. This signal indicates that information may leak between processes or users through shared resources.
applicability: Applicable to all multi-user and multi-tenant systems. Includes memory isolation, process separation, storage partitioning, and shared resource access controls.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through system isolation configuration review, memory protection verification, and shared resource access testing.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
